summary: Sega AM2's 1990 motorcycle racing game, released with two-player motion-simulator and upright arcade cabinets before Master System and Game Gear versions.

entries.title: GP Rider

emulation.notes: Use arcade emulation or original hardware; original motion hardware is needed for the cabinet feel.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Sega X Board arcade presentation with modern scaling; motion simulator only on original cabinet

primary.version: Original Sega X Board arcade release
primary.why: GP Rider was developed by Sega AM2 for arcades on Sega X Board hardware, with a two-player motion-simulator cabinet and a standard upright cabinet. The arcade release is the highest-fidelity route; the Game Gear version is sourced as essentially a rebranded Super Hang-On.
primary.how_to_play: Play the arcade version in MAME/original hardware; choose the two-player motion-simulator cabinet where available.

entries.remaster_caveats: Game Gear GP Rider is effectively a Super Hang-On rebrand rather than a faithful GP Rider arcade conversion.
